name: app.custompaintbynumber/paint-by-number
title: Custom Paint by Number helper
description: Custom paint by number help: color count and print size advice, tiles, PDF contents, paint mixing.

tools.name: recommend_colors_and_size
tools.description: Recommend 24, 36 or 48 colors and an A4, A3 or 16×20 in print size for a custom paint by number, from the subject and how much detail the painter wants.

subject.description: pet, person (portrait), landscape, sky_or_sunset or other

detail.description: simple (bold, relaxing), balanced, or detailed (keeps gradients and fine detail; a longer project)

first_project.description: True for a first paint by number or a beginner

tools.name: print_size_facts
tools.description: Page size (mm, cm, inches), picture area and how many overlapping Letter/A4 tiles each print size (A4, A3, 16×20 in) needs for a photo’s aspect ratio.

size.description: a4, a3 or 16x20; omit for all three

aspect_ratio.description: Photo width:height, e.g. "3:4" (portrait phone photo) or "4:3" (landscape)

tools.name: pattern_pdf_contents
tools.description: What the $9.99 custom paint by number PDF includes (outline, color chart with HEX/RGB and mixing recipes, painted reference, tiles), the price, re-download and refund terms.

tools.name: paint_mixing_recipe
tools.description: Mixing recipe in whole parts for any HEX color from a basic eight-paint acrylic set, with how close the mix gets (the same recipe the PDF color chart prints).

tools.name: how_to_make_from_photo
tools.description: Step-by-step: choosing the photo, size and color count, previewing, printing or transferring to canvas, mixing and painting. Includes the link to the free in-browser generator.
